feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. The evidence is iterations 0 to 9. Iteration 9 (y = 0.06 m, kd 0.8, score 620.55) is the best raced design and the base to hold if y = 0.07 m fails. Oval finished 20 of 20, and s-bend finished 17 of 20 with mean max_error 0.040 m. Slalom still ends off-track in all trials, with mean max_error 0.066 m and progress 0.19, so slalom is the limiting track. Iteration 8 showed that moving the row from y = 0.04 to y = 0.06 m raised oval finishes from 0.70 to 0.95 and slalom progress from 0.12 to 0.16. It also raised s-bend steering oscillation from 0.27 to 0.36, which is why I added kd 0.8 in iteration 9. The forward offset therefore makes the controller work harder on bends, and it is not a clear fix for slalom max_error. Iteration 9 confirmed that kd 0.8 with the y = 0.06 m row raised the score by 217 over iteration 8, so the controller change worked. Your y = 0.07 m step is a reasonable next test under the keep rule you stated. Be realistic about slalom: a forward offset alone is unlikely to move slalom max_error from about 0.066 m below 0.06 m, and slalom completion is unlikely in this iteration. Depending on the next race: if the oval finish rate is at least 0.9 and slalom max_error falls below 0.06 m, keep y = 0.07 m. If the oval finish rate is between 0.8 and 0.9 with slalom max_error still at or above 0.06 m, keep y = 0.06 m and treat slalom as a controller problem. If the oval finish rate is below 0.8, return to y = 0.06 m. Do not test further forward offsets beyond y = 0.07 m, and do not revisit sensor_size, wheel_track, mass or body width, since iterations 2 to 5 showed each one cut the oval finish rate.
requested_changes: Keep y = 0.07 m only if the oval finish rate is at least 0.9 and slalom max_error falls below 0.06 m, compared with iteration 9 (oval 1.00, slalom max_error 0.066 m).
If the oval finish rate falls below 0.8, return to the iteration 9 row at y = 0.06 m with kd 0.8 and stop testing forward offsets.

Keep sensor_size 0.012 m, wheel_track 0.12 m, mass 0.8 kg and x = -0.024 to +0.024 m fixed. Slalom max_error is now a controller problem, so the Integrator will address it through kd, kp or base_speed rather than another geometry change.
